svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 4 mm rod 7 mm long with a 6 mm flange 1 mm thick, 3 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its outer end; a 3 mm pocket 2.5 deep in its inner end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print standing on its outer end, 100 % infill, so light runs along it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: push it through the 4.4 mm hole from inside the front shell

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: until the flange sits on the inner face; it stands 1 mm proud

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside. A drop of clear adhesive on the flange holds it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push the 3 mm red LED into the pocket; a drop of adhesive.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the LED lit by a 3 V coin cell shows clearly outside.
